detect.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no package.json, this is not a JavaScript or TypeScript project" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -z "$(find . \( -name node_modules -o -name .git \) -prune -o -name '*.html' -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: accessibility unavailable, no local HTML fixtures found" >&2
  exit 78
fi
printf '%s\n' "$pm"

enabledShifts.fallback: automated checks; not WCAG or user conformance — record local HTML paths and any configured scanner output when @axe-core/cli is unavailable

maintenance.check: lastVerified older than 180 days, or the pinned range no longer resolves in the manager the lockfile names

packageManagerAdditions.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
declared="$(sed -n 's/.*"packageManager"[^"]*"//p' package.json | cut -d@ -f1 | head -n 1)"
if [ -n "$declared" ] && [ "$declared" != "$pm" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: package.json names $declared, the lockfile names $pm" >&2
  exit 78
fi
ver="$(node -v 2>/dev/null)" || ver=""
major="${ver#v}"
major="${major%%.*}"
case "$major" in "" | *[!0-9]*) major=0 ;; esac
if [ "$major" -lt 20 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: this recipe needs Node 20 or newer, the host reports major $major" >&2
  exit 78
fi
html="$(find . \( -name node_modules -o -name .git \) -prune -o -name '*.html' -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
if [ -z "$html" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: accessibility unavailable, no local HTML fixtures found" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm install --save-dev "@axe-core/cli@^4.10.0"; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm add --save-dev "@axe-core/cli@^4.10.0"; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn add --dev "@axe-core/cli@^4.10.0"; fi

permissionRequirements: fallback: automated checks; not WCAG or user conformance — axe scans local HTML only; no browser session or assistive-technology emulation
fallback: pa11y on PATH satisfies probe when configured; this recipe does not install a global runner
fallback: projects without local HTML report unavailable; the recipe never fetches remote pages

probe.command:
for f in axe.config.js axe.config.mjs axe.config.cjs .pa11yci .pa11yci.json; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi
done
if grep -qE '"(@axe-core/cli|pa11y|pa11y-ci)"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
if grep -qE '"(a11y|accessibility|axe|pa11y)"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
command -v pa11y >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
exit 1

rollback.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm uninstall @axe-core/cli
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm remove @axe-core/cli
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn remove @axe-core/cli
fi

smoke.command:
html="$(find . \( -name node_modules -o -name .git \) -prune -o -name '*.html' -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
if [ -z "$html" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: accessibility smoke needs a local HTML file" >&2
  exit 78
fi
url="file://$(cd "$(dirname "$html")" && pwd)/$(basename "$html")"
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm exec --no -- axe "$url" --stdout --exit
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm exec axe "$url" --stdout --exit
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn run axe "$url" --stdout --exit
else
  echo "nightshift: no lockfile, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
